title: Cadence orchestration and LTS-channel fencing — weekly cut playbook
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Problem: Our weekly build cadence has diverged across teams and we lack a deterministic fence between weekly RC promotions and LTS channel inclusion. This leads to accidental LTS bumps, noisy release notes, and inconsistent rollback playbooks.

Goal: Define a single source-of-truth weekly cut playbook (the "cut-orbit"), enforce an LTS-channel fencing policy, and fully automate RC tagging + human-reviewed release-note synthesis. Deliver an end-to-end workflow: cut -> automated smoke -> canary rollout -> RC promotion -> LTS fencing gate -> final LTS inclusion.

Scope: Release orchestration decisions and automation for weekly builds (hosted and dedicated model runtime), RC tagging conventions, changelog automation, metrics-based canary gates, and handoff runbook for on-call + release duty. Not in scope: model-variant promotion (separate model-onboarding flows).
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible weekly cut (cut-orbit) can be started from the release UI or CLI with a single command
RC tags are created automatically using the agreed naming scheme (vX.Y.Z-rcN) and pushed to git with a change log draft
Automated smoke + canary pipeline runs and records pass/fail metrics to the release dashboard
LTS fence prevents any RC from being auto-promoted into the LTS channel until 72-hour stabilization window or a manual override with audit
Release notes generated into a consumable draft with AI-summarized highlights + linked PRs, and a one-click publish flow
Rollback instructions and an upgrade assistant bundle are attached to every LTS inclusion
Handbook (runbook) entries updated and validated by on-call in a dry-run
steps: Define canonical tagging convention: semantic version base + channel suffix (example: 1.22.0-rc1, 1.22.0-lts1)
Implement release-orbit GitHub Action (release-orbit.yml) to: create cut branch, run smoke tests, build artifacts, and create RC tag
Wire canary pipeline to SmartRouter: initial 1% traffic for 30m, 10% for 2h, 100% after gates pass; metrics feed to release dashboard
Add LTS fence service: evaluates stabilization window (72 hours) + metrics thresholds (error-rate <0.1%, p95 latency <1.5x baseline); returns pass/fail
Changelog automation: generate PR list, group by component, run heuristics to create changelog bullets, then pass to ai-summarizer job for human-readable highlights
Expose manual override in Console with SSO audit: only members of release-engineering and PM on-call can force promote into LTS
Publish final release notes and attach upgrade assistant artifacts to release record (kustomize patches, Helm values diff, migration notes)
notes: Fencing rationale: LTS channel is a stronger SLA — we must avoid churn from weekly instability. The fence enforces a stabilization period and objective gates before an RC becomes LTS.
We will reuse existing metrics (datadog:infra.runtime.error_rate, infra.runtime.p95_token) and add a release-specific dashboard to show canary cohorts.
Naming: avoid overloaded term 'cut' externally; internal docs will call this the 'cut-orbit' to reduce confusion with LTS 'cut'.
This ticket is focused on engineering and automation; PM will own final copy and release cadence comms (see related PM ticket).
